summary.key_theme: 市場對 Tesla 的機器人 Optimus 與 Robotaxi 願景充滿期待，但同時面臨中國市場召回、Cybertruck 定價策略及高估值帶來的獲利壓力。

bullish.title: Optimus Just Entered Production at Fremont. Here's What Changes for Tesla Investors.
bullish.reason: Optimus 進入生產階段是 Tesla 從汽車製造商轉型為 AI 與機器人巨頭的關鍵里程碑，具備長期營收成長潛力。

bullish.title: Tesla Stock Is Trending Higher Today: What's Happening? — Tesla Inc (NASDAQ:TSLA) shares are rising Thursday. The company's official Robotaxi account announced expanded servi
bullish.reason: Robotaxi 服務擴張的消息直接提振了市場對 Tesla 自動駕駛商業化進程的信心。

bullish.title: Jason Calacanis Says TSLA's Optimus Will Eclipse AAPL's iPhone, Predicts 1 Billion Robots By 2036
bullish.reason: 知名投資人對 Optimus 的長期市場規模給予極高評價，強化了市場對 Tesla 估值溢價的認同感。

bullish.title: Elon Musk Teases Tesla Vehicle 'Way Cooler Than a Minivan'—Is the Robovan Finally Coming?
bullish.reason: 新車型預告有助於維持品牌熱度與市場對未來產品線的期待。

bullish.title: Japan's Terra Charge To Roll Out Tesla-Compatible EV Charging Stations
bullish.reason: 與日本充電樁業者合作擴大 NACS 充電網絡，有助於鞏固 Tesla 在充電標準領域的領導地位。

bullish.title: Elon Musk Says 1 Million Optimus Robots, 1 GW of Solar Could Drive Galaxy-Wide Expansion
bullish.reason: Musk 的宏大願景雖具遠見，但對短期股價影響較小，主要作為長期投資敘事。

bullish.title: If You Invested $1000 In Tesla Stock 10 Years Ago, You Would Have This Much Today
bullish.reason: 回顧歷史績效，強化投資人對公司長期成長能力的信心。

bearish.title: Tesla recalls 3 million vehicles in China over doorhandle safety, driver monitoring
bearish.reason: 大規模召回涉及 300 萬輛車，不僅影響品牌聲譽，亦可能產生額外維修成本並引發中國監管機構關注。

bearish.title: Tesla Stock Sits Nearly 30% Below Its High and Still Trades at 330 Times Earnings
bearish.reason: 高達 330 倍的本益比在當前市場環境下顯得過於昂貴，凸顯了股價回調的風險。

bearish.title: Elon Musk's Tesla Hikes Cybertruck Prices by More Than 7% Despite Sluggish Sales
bearish.reason: 在銷售疲軟的情況下調漲價格，可能進一步抑制需求並影響 Cybertruck 的市場滲透率。

bearish.title: Tesla Sets Cybercab Launch Event for September 3 but Prediction Markets Doubt It'll Impress
bearish.reason: 預測市場對 Cybercab 的發布信心不足，顯示投資人對產品交付能力與成本控制存有疑慮。

bearish.title: TSLA Competitor? Xiaomi Joins NIO in Race to Build In-House Chips for Self-Driving Cars
bearish.reason: 中國競爭對手在自研晶片領域的進展，對 Tesla 的技術護城河構成長期挑戰。

bearish.title: EXCLUSIVE: Tesla Isn't Leading Humanoid Robotics—Figure AI Is, RoboStrategy CEO Says
bearish.reason: 分析師觀點指出競爭對手在商業化進程上可能領先，削弱了 Tesla 在機器人領域的獨占敘事。

neutral.title: Tesla Denies It’s Pulling Back on FSD in China
neutral.reason: 公司澄清謠言，消除了市場對中國業務縮減的擔憂，屬於防禦性消息。

neutral.title: Tesla's Optimus Rival Could Be Worth $6 Billion As SoftBank Circles OpenAI-Backed 1X
neutral.reason: 提及競爭對手估值，對 Tesla 本身無直接財務影響，僅供市場參考。

neutral.title: EXCLUSIVE: Tesla's Biggest Robotics Advantage Isn't AI, RoboStrategy CEO Says
neutral.reason: 強調製造規模而非 AI，屬於對公司競爭優勢的技術性討論。

neutral.title: Elon Musk Reveals Why SpaceX Launched Tesla’s Roadster Into Orbit
neutral.reason: 屬於歷史回顧與花絮，對當前股價無實質影響。

neutral.title: Tesla's Website Shows Updated US Cybertruck Pricing
neutral.reason: 僅為價格變動的資訊披露，已在後續分析中納入影響評估。

neutral.title: Crypto Prediction Market Weighs 2026 Launch Odds
neutral.reason: 基於加密貨幣市場的投機性預測，參考價值有限。

neutral.title: Tesla (TSLA) Is Recalling Nearly 3 Million Vehicles In China
neutral.reason: 與 CNBC 報導內容重複，已選取 CNBC 作為代表。
